description: This file defines a PHP class CustomerModel in the OrangeHRM Time API module. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits to handle serialization of Customer entity data into a model suitable for API responses in a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: CustomerModel
classes.description: A model class representing customer data for API responses, encapsulating the Customer entity with serialization and filtering configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CustomerModel with a Customer entity, setting up attribute filters and names for serialization.
